findings.text: The company has no insolvency record held by Companies House.
Accounts are not overdue; the next accounts are due 31 December 2027, and the accounts were last made up to 31 March 2026.
The confirmation statement is not overdue; it was last made up to 11 November 2025 and the next is due 25 November 2026.
There are 9 current officers, comprising 8 directors and 1 other officer.
Since 24 October 2025, 3 officer appointments and 8 resignations have been filed, including the appointment of PERSON 665 on 1 June 2026 and the resignations of several directors on 20 July 2026.
The company has 4 charges registered, of which 2 are outstanding and 2 are satisfied.
The company has one current person with significant control, CORPORATE CONTROLLER 2850, which holds 75 to 100 percent of shares and voting rights.
Across the 5 current directors checked, 40 other companies were found, including 1 in administration, and directors' links to that company are noted as a low-level red flag.
